global_invariants.system_role: AES-128 encryption system with top-level flow control, iterative key expansion, and reusable combinational S-box substitution

clocking_model.reset_style: Synchronous initialization across clock domain; top uses rst, submodules use kld or synchronous load; polarity unspecified, assumed active-high for consistency

cross_module_alignment: aes_cipher_top, aes_key_expand_128, and aes_rcon share the primary clk domain
aes_sbox is a shared reusable leaf instantiated in both aes_cipher_top and aes_key_expand_128
Key expansion outputs feed round keys to the top-level cipher datapath
global_data_conventions: 128-bit state matrix arranged in column-major order
One AES round processed per clock cycle in top module

repo_notes: Pure combinational logic; no clock or reset ports

modules.role: Registered round constant generator with internal counter
repo_notes: Uses kld as synchronous reset/load control instead of global rst
Synchronous key loading controlled by kld signal

modules.role: Top-level AES-128 cipher controller and datapath integrator
repo_notes: Owns top-level FSM and coordinates encryption phases

top_level_integration_notes: Top module FSM drives one-round-per-cycle encryption using expanded keys
Shared aes_sbox must be instantiated separately in top-level and key expansion paths

open_issues: Reset polarity for rst signal is unspecified in the contract
Exact assertion duration and deassertion timing for the done signal is not defined
aes_key_expand_128 total cycle count and synchronization with top-level encryption phases is not explicitly stated
aes_rcon overflow behavior (rcnt > 9) specifies output remains 0 but exact recovery timing is underspecified
S-box pipeline register placement and timing impact are left to external design decisions
